svg.aria-label: Breathing and the core cylinder — 呼吸与核心圆筒

text.aria-label: Breathing and the core cylinder — 呼吸与核心圆筒
A. Quiet inspiration (anterior view) — A. 平静吸气（前面观）
End of expiration (dashed) — 呼气末的膈（虚线）
Inspiration: flatter and lower — 吸气时的膈：变平并下降
text.tspan: 吸气时的膈：变平并下降

text.aria-label: Lower ribs move up and out — 下位肋骨向外上方抬起
text.tspan: Lower ribs move up and out
下位肋骨向外上方抬起

text.aria-label: External intercostals lift the ribs — 肋间外肌上提肋骨
Quiet expiration is passive: the diaphragm relaxes back to the dashed line. — 平静呼气是被动的：膈放松，回到虚线位置。
text.tspan: Quiet expiration is passive: the diaphragm relaxes back to the dashed line.
平静呼气是被动的：膈放松，回到虚线位置。

text.aria-label: The phrenic nerve and both diaphragm positions are schematic. — 膈神经和膈的两个位置均为示意。
text.tspan: The phrenic nerve and both diaphragm positions are schematic.
膈神经和膈的两个位置均为示意。

text.aria-label: B. The core cylinder (side view, front to the left) — B. 核心圆筒（侧面观，前方在左）
text.tspan: B. The core cylinder (side view, front to the left)
B. 核心圆筒（侧面观，前方在左）

text.aria-label: Floor: pelvic floor — 底：盆底（肛提肌）
Front and sides: abdominal wall — 前壁和侧壁：腹横肌等腹肌
text.tspan: 前壁和侧壁：腹横肌等腹肌

text.aria-label: Back: deep back muscles — 后壁：多裂肌等背部深层肌
text.tspan: 后壁：多裂肌等背部深层肌

text.aria-label: When the four walls contract together, intra-abdominal pressure rises and the lumbar spine is stiffened. — 四面壁一起收缩时，腹内压升高，腰椎变得稳固。
text.tspan: When the four walls contract together, intra-abdominal pressure rises and the lumbar spine is stiffened.
四面壁一起收缩时，腹内压升高，腰椎变得稳固。

text.aria-label: When pressure rises in a cough or a lift, the pelvic floor has to contract with the other walls. — 咳嗽或提重物使腹内压升高时，盆底要和其他几面壁一起收缩。
text.tspan: When pressure rises in a cough or a lift, the pelvic floor has to contract with the other walls.
咳嗽或提重物使腹内压升高时，盆底要和其他几面壁一起收缩。
Schematic; pathway and layers are simplified.
解剖示意；走行与层次经过简化。
